Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting quotas in the enforcement of traffic laws.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the enforcement of traffic laws; adding a newsection to chapter 46.64 RCW; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.64 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No law enforcement officer shall be required to do any of thefollowing: (a) Issue a specific number of citations, notices of infraction, orwarning notices during any specified time period for violations oftraffic regulations; (b) Stop a specific number of persons or vehicles during anyspecified time period for the purpose of preventing or detectingviolations of traffic regulations; (c) Make a specific number of arrests during any specified timeperiod for traffic laws under chapter 46.61 RCW. (2) The number of citations, notices of infraction, or warningnotices issued by a law enforcement officer for violations of trafficregulations and the number of traffic stops and arrests made by a lawenforcement officer for violations of traffic laws under chapter 46.61 p. 1 HB 2973RCW shall not be given greater consideration than any other factor thatis used in deciding the law enforcement officer's job assignment orpromotion or in evaluating the performance of the law enforcementofficer. (3) This section shall not be construed as superseding the duty ofa law enforcement officer to maintain public order, keep and preservethe peace, protect the public health, safety, and welfare, and enforcethe laws of the state of Washington. (4) "Law enforcement officer" has the same meaning as "peaceofficer" given in RCW 43.101.010.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
